query: Use Audited data only. For each Account use its latest Event time, regardless of row position. How many accounts are Active at that latest event? Answer only the integer.
Use Audited data only. For each Account use its latest Event time. Sum Balance for accounts Active at that event. Answer only the integer.
Use Audited data only. For each Account use its latest Event time. Which Active account has the largest Balance? Break ties alphabetically; answer only the Account.
Use Audited data only. For each Account use its latest Event time. What percentage of distinct accounts are Closed at their latest event? Answer to two decimals, no percent sign.
Use Audited data only. For each Account use its latest Event time. What is the average Balance of Active accounts at that event? Answer to two decimal places.
Use Audited data only. For each Account use its latest Event time. How many latest events are strictly before 2028-05-12 00:00? Answer only the integer.
Use Audited data only. How many event records are in the table, counting historical versions separately? Answer only the integer.

Use Audited data only. For each Account use its latest Event time. List the three Active accounts with largest Balance in descending Balance order, ties alphabetically. Separate names with comma and space.
Use Audited data only. Among single projects with Cost <= 80 and Staff <= 4, which has highest Benefit? Break ties alphabetically; answer only the Project.
Use Audited data only. How many single projects satisfy both Cost <= 80 and Staff <= 4? Answer only the integer.
Use Audited data only. Select exactly two different projects with combined Cost <= 140 and combined Staff <= 7. What is the maximum combined Benefit? Answer only the integer.

Use Audited data only. Select exactly two different projects with combined Cost <= 140 and Staff <= 7 to maximize combined Benefit. Break equal-benefit ties by alphabetically sorted project names. List the chosen pair alphabetically, separated by comma and space.
Use Audited data only. How many unordered pairs of different projects have combined Cost <= 140 and combined Staff <= 7? Answer only the integer.
Use Audited data only. Among single projects with Cost <= 80 and Staff <= 4, which has highest Benefit divided by Cost? Break ties alphabetically; answer only the Project.
Use Audited data only. Among single projects with Cost <= 80 and Staff <= 4, sum their Cost. Answer only the integer.

Use Audited data only. Select exactly two different projects with combined Cost <= 140 and Staff <= 7 to maximize Benefit. Break equal-benefit ties by alphabetically sorted project names. What is the pair's combined Cost? Answer only the integer.
Use Audited data only. Clip every shift to 2028-06-07 09:00 through 17:00. What is total worker-minutes inside that window, counting overlapping shifts separately? Answer only the integer.
Use Audited data only. Clip every shift to 2028-06-07 09:00 through 17:00. Sum each shift's clipped hours times its Hourly rate. Answer to two decimal places.
Use Audited data only. How many shifts overlap 2028-06-07 09:00 through 17:00 by a positive duration? Touching an endpoint alone does not count. Answer only the integer.
Use Audited data only. How many distinct Workers have positive-duration overlap with 2028-06-07 09:00 through 17:00? Answer only the integer.

Use Audited data only. Clip shifts to 2028-06-07 09:00 through 17:00 and price clipped hours by Hourly rate. Which Worker has the highest summed cost? Break ties alphabetically; answer only the Worker.
Use Audited data only. What is total duration in minutes of all complete shifts without clipping? Answer only the integer.
Use Audited data only. How many shifts start strictly before 2028-06-07 09:00? Answer only the integer.
Use Audited data only. Clip shifts to 2028-06-07 09:00 through 17:00 and price clipped hours by Hourly rate. What is summed cost for Worker-11? Answer to two decimal places.
Use Audited data only. Sort by Date ascending. On which date was the largest increase from the preceding recorded date? Break ties by earliest Date; answer YYYY-MM-DD.
Use Audited data only. Sort by Date ascending. What is the largest Level increase from the preceding recorded date? Answer only the signed integer.
Use Audited data only. Sort by Date ascending. On which date was the smallest signed change from the preceding recorded date? Break ties by earliest Date; answer YYYY-MM-DD.
Use Audited data only. Sort by Date ascending. How many consecutive-date changes in Level are negative? Answer only the integer.

Use Audited data only. Sort by Date ascending. Compute the trailing three-record arithmetic mean of Level, including each date and its preceding two records. On which ending date is this mean highest? Break ties by earliest date; answer YYYY-MM-DD.
Use Audited data only. Sort by Date ascending. What is the highest trailing three-record arithmetic mean of Level? Answer to two decimal places.
Use Audited data only. What is last Level minus first Level by Date ascending? Keep the sign; answer only the integer.
Use Audited data only. What is the relative change from first Level to last Level by Date ascending, as a percent of first Level? Answer to two decimal places, no percent sign.
